paragraphs: AI: "Artificial Intelligence, Climate Change, and Global Security: Why the World Needs International Regulation Now" (EIN News) leads the coverage. Also notable: "Director Blows $1.5 Million Generating Horrendous AI Slop Movie, Says AI Actually Saved Him Tens of Millions" (Futurism).

Political: "The Lindsay Clancy case exposes the insanity defense loophole" (Washington Examiner) leads the coverage. Also notable: "I worked for 3 White House press secretaries — here's some advice for the next one" (The Hill).

Economic: "Noah Adams, longtime host of NPR's All Things Considered, has died" (NPR) leads the coverage. Also notable: "Former Treasury official cautions against raising interest rates ahead of midterms" (Fox News).

Financial: "Elizabeth Holmes Documentary ‘You Can See Everything’ Opens to Over 2,000 Sold-Out Shows" (The New York Times) leads the coverage. Also notable: "SL Green putting finishing touches on $225M redesign at 245 Park Ave." (New York Post).

Geopolitical: "Kenya Confirms Four New Ebola Cases" (The New York Times) leads the coverage. Also notable: "Zelensky says 'of course' Ukraine trusts the US, hopes Trump will 'change his decisions'" (The Hill).
